# Ergzo

> AI-powered ergonomic risk assessment for workplaces. Ergzo turns any smartphone
> camera into an ergonomic assessment tool, scoring musculoskeletal risk with 15
> globally validated methods and producing instant reports, body-part risk maps
> and corrective action plans.

Ergzo is built by Ergzo Solutions Private Limited (India) for EHS professionals,
safety managers, occupational health teams, ergonomists and factory managers.
The product is currently pre-launch and operating a waitlist for iOS and Android.

## What Ergzo does

- **AI pose detection** — analyses a worker's posture from a phone camera or an
  uploaded photo/video. No wearables, sensors or specialist hardware.
- **15 validated assessment tools** — REBA, RULA, ROSA, WISHA, SNOOK, NIOSH,
  WERA, QEC, CMDQ, JSI, MAC, OCRA, MANTRA, OWAS and PATH.
- **Instant risk scoring** — colour-coded risk bands (low, medium, high, very
  high) with a joint-by-joint body risk map.
- **Corrective action plans** — prioritised recommendations grouped by urgency.
- **Before/after intervention tracking** — re-assess after a fix and compare
  scores side by side, with estimated payback period.
- **Team analytics** — department-wise risk distribution, assessment history and
  estimated annual injury exposure.
- **Reporting** — branded PDF reports plus CSV and Excel export for compliance
  records.

## Team

- **Founder — Dr. Tanay Prabhu Lawande, MBBS, AFIH.** An occupational health
  physician. AFIH (Associate Fellowship in Industrial Health) is the
  qualification India requires of a Factory Medical Officer. Previously a site
  doctor in construction, and Factory Medical Officer and Occupational Health
  Physician at Crompton.
- **Co-founder — Vaibhavi Prabhu Lawande.** An IT engineer by education. Works on
  the application alongside the founder and owns brand, content and demand
  generation, including outreach at industry expos.

## Key facts

- A full assessment takes roughly 4–8 minutes per task, versus 20–45 minutes for
  a traditional paper-based REBA or RULA assessment.
- Musculoskeletal disorders account for roughly 38% of occupational illnesses
  globally.
- Ergzo is a workplace screening and risk-analysis tool. It is not a medical
  device and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. Outputs should be
  reviewed by a qualified ergonomist or safety professional.
- Assessment media is processed on-device by design; raw photos and videos are
  not uploaded unless the user explicitly exports or shares them.
- India-first, aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023.
